fields.description: Oceana brings apartments and penthouses to Fujairah’s shoreline. Smaller studios and junior one-bedroom layouts sit alongside family apartments and larger top-floor homes; their terraces and interior areas vary substantially by type.

sources.label: Property Finder · Oceana secondary commercial reference

overview: The 605-home mix includes 72 studios, 20 junior one-bedroom, 242 one-bedroom, 227 two-bedroom, 36 three-bedroom apartments and eight penthouses.
research.locationNote: Fujairah shoreline; the developer does not name a smaller district.
research.priceNote: Property Finder labels AED 526k as a launch price and gives AED 526,250 in its description. No current developer unit quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists six alternatives: 10/44/46, full payment, 20/44/36, 30/44/26, 30/70 and 20/10/70. The table shows its first option; original developer payment terms remain unverified.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts June 2029. No dated primary delivery commitment was retrieved. The developer’s undated 0% construction label is not a current progress certificate.
